notesStmt.note: As Horace Traubel's notation in the bottom right corner indicates, this document is the title page "design made on a copy of the rejected portrait" mentioned in Horace Traubel's record of his visit to Whitman on October 28, 1888 (see med.00002.100).
This is an early mock-up of the title page for Complete Poems & Prose, which Whitman self-published near the end of 1888.
